description: This file defines the RetrieveAttributeStrategy class that handles the retrieval of specific attributes from a Thing object in Eclipse Ditto. It processes RetrieveAttribute commands, extracts attribute values, and constructs response events, integrating with Ditto's JSON and metadata models.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a strategy to handle RetrieveAttribute commands by extracting attributes from a Thing and constructing corresponding results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to process a RetrieveAttribute command, returning a Result of ThingEvent based on attribute extraction and command parameters.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the Attributes object from a given Thing, or throws if the Thing is null.

methods.name: getAttributeValueResult
methods.description: Generates a Result containing a ThingEvent response for the specified attribute if found, or an error if not.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Determines the previous EntityTag for the command and previous entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the next EntityTag for a new entity based on its attributes.
